create_LUDenseSolver: create an LUDenseSolver instance with an Objective to solve linear systems using LU decomposition
create_CholeskyDenseSolver: create a CholeskyDenseSolver instance with an Objective to solve linear systems using Cholesky decomposition
run_DenseSolver_solve: run the solve method on a DenseSolver with optional damping and ellipsoidal damping parameters
apply_DenseSolver_damping: apply ellipsoidal or isotropic damping to a batch of square matrices using DenseSolver._apply_damping
review_DenseSolver_check_singular: review the DenseSolver solve method singular matrix detection and filtering logic for batched systems
